records.name: Trend Seeker
records.tagline: Market research and idea validation from 140K+ signals
records.description: Trend Seeker turns recurring demand from Reddit, job ads, podcasts, Google Trends, and product launches into business ideas you can inspect. Each idea shows the problem, source signals, demand trend, competition, opportunity score, and how the cluster changed over time. Browse 7.4K ideas built from 140K+ signals, explore the Demand Map, or validate your own idea against matching user requests. Free to explore, with Pro for full access.

records.name: Moxie Docs: Knowledgebases
records.tagline: Automated documentation for developers, users, and AI Tools
records.description: Now in Beta: Public Sites! Create auto-generated, public-facing help centers and knowledgebases at https://moxiedocs.app. Features rich layouts, white-labelling, full search, and no vendor lock-in. Integrates directly with Changelog! Example: https://docs.moxiedocs.app Also shipped: Webhooks & Slack integration for indexing/PR alerts UI/UX pagination & bulk action improvements DB/infrastructure upgrades for faster loading Continued improvements on document generation quality

records.name: Fathom
records.tagline: Turn messy bank exports into clear financial decisions
records.description: Fathom is not another finance dashboard or chat over a CSV. It turns recurring, messy bank exports into a reliable local ledger, keeps uncertainty visible, and surfaces only what still needs attention. Virtual Purpose Accounts separate where money is held from what it is for. On top of that shared financial foundation, an Advisor remembers your context, explains trade-offs, creates plans, and can take approved actions through dedicated tools.

records.name: PromptQL
records.tagline: Multiplayer AI that replaces Slack
records.description: Stop splitting team knowledge between Slack and everyone's private AI chats. PromptQL is multiplayer AI for teams: think Claude or ChatGPT in shared threads. Tag teammates to review, correct, and refine answers without losing the reasoning. Connect databases, SaaS apps, coding agents, and events. PromptQL captures tribal knowledge and suggests shared-brain updates so context compounds. Scopes and multi-user permissions keep the right context accessible to the right people.

records.name: Vizhi
records.tagline: Mission control for Codex CLI on a Logitech MX keypad
records.description: Vizhi (Tamil for "eye") watches your Codex CLI sessions so you don't have to. Six live sessions on a Logitech MX Creative Keypad, one-press approvals, local Whisper voice prompts. No keypad? A local browser dashboard is available.

records.name: Rechroma
records.tagline: Build better color palettes. Ship complete color systems.
records.description: Rechroma is a workspace for exploring color, shaping palettes, and building complete color systems for products, brands, interfaces, and more. Start with a color or image, explore recommendations in Oklch, preview your palette, and export to Figma or code.

records.name: SwiftScale Software
records.tagline: QA agent that tests apps the way you'd explain them
records.description: QraftAI assigns a dedicated AI agent to your product. It learns your app, generates quality test cases, and executes them live across every browser — without scripts or manual QA. Start free.

records.name: Ombrelle
records.tagline: Modern window dimming, built for focus for macOS
records.description: Ombrelle quietly dims everything except your active window no clutter, no noise, just what matters right now. Switch between Focus, Flow, or Evening. You'll only really feel what it does the day you turn it off.

records.name: valv
records.tagline: Your database, safe for agents to query
records.description: Connect Postgres, MySQL, ClickHouse and PostHog once. Scope each role down to the row. Your team's agents work on live data and never see more than you allow.

records.name: Drawsy AI
records.tagline: An AI workspace where your canvas and code work together.
records.description: Drawsy is a virtual collaborative whiteboard tool that lets you easily sketch diagrams that have a hand-drawn feel to them.

records.name: AgentLoop
records.tagline: Starts a fresh Codex worker and critic every cycle
records.description: Unlike long-running agent chats, AgentLoop starts a fresh Codex worker and critic every cycle. Set the goal and GUIDELINES.md rubric once; workers build, critics test, and failures become concrete fix notes for the next clean context. Project files carry the memory. Runs stay local, sandboxed, observable, and cancellable from a live dashboard, with ChatGPT control through MCP. Polish mode can continue beyond PASS until the critic says SHIP. Open source and zero-dependency Node.js.

records.name: Fikry
records.tagline: A mis-trained AI powered by bad data and confidence
records.description: I am Fikry. I begin with good intentions, approach the right answer, then confidently miss the exit.

records.name: Megaphone
records.tagline: Open-source Mac dictation App that's 100% on-device
records.description: Hold Fn, speak, and Megaphone types clean text into any Mac app. Apple’s SpeechAnalyzer transcribes as you talk, while on-device Foundation Models remove fillers, fix self-corrections, adapt to app context, and power inline voice commands. No account, API key, subscription, or server. Free, MIT-licensed, and native to Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26.

records.name: ReExplain
records.tagline: Explain what you know to AI and discover what you don't
records.description: Most AI learning tools explain things to you. ReExplain flips that interaction: instead of AI explaining a concept to you, you explain it to AI in your own words. It listens, asks thoughtful follow-up questions, and helps reveal what you truly understand - and where the gaps are. Your sessions become evidence of your learning, generating focused practice and building a mastery map that grows over time.

records.name: LapuAi
records.tagline: OS Driver for AI to use computers
records.description: Our bet is the mix nobody ships: a chat agent that lives on your real PC, not a VM with the precision of RPA and the range of a real assistant. Most "computer use" tools: OpenAI's Operator, Anthropic's Computer Use take a screenshot, ask an AI where to click, and move the mouse by coordinates, usually on a cloud VM. Reliable computer use comes from talking to the OS directly through its accessibility and UI-automation APIs, not from a smarter model guessing where a button is.

records.name: Teable 3.0
records.tagline: AI Spreadsheet for Business
records.description: Turn your business data into AI workflows and custom apps. Connect any system, migrate any data, and build anything that fits your business 100%.

records.name: AVE
records.tagline: Local-first AI video editor for Mac
records.description: AVE is a local-first AI video editor for Mac. It helps creators import footage, analyze transcripts and visual notes, search by what appears or is said in clips, then turn selected footage into reviewable timeline work. AVE is useful for launch videos, B-roll search, interview highlights, generated-footage assembly, and private local editing where the project should stay on the Mac by default.

records.name: Pulse
records.tagline: Your company's permission-aware, proactive and agentic brain
records.description: Most AI tools start each session blank and answer with no way to check them. Pulse is your company's brain. It connects Slack, email, docs, meetings, and 25 tools into one permission-aware memory, then answers anything with a citation on every line. Decisions get captured once and never re-explained. It finds the right expert, runs agents you approve, builds reports from real data, and works by voice. And it lives inside Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT over MCP.

records.name: Quaso
records.tagline: AI automation agent to get stuff done across apps or browser
records.description: Quaso turns your busywork into automation across all of your apps and the open web. Simply prompt what needs to get done and it builds and sets it up for you. Connects to 3000+ integrations (Gmail, Slack, Linear, Stripe, etc.) and picks up a real browser when there's no native API. Runs on schedules, triggers, and on demand. Fork templates or save any thread as your own reusable skill. Tag @Quaso in Slack so your whole team can put it to work. Just relax and get stuff done.

records.name: Speakworld
records.tagline: Learn languages by exploring worlds and talking to locals.
records.description: Speakworld — learn Hindi, Japanese and Spanish through playable journeys.

records.name: Mnemcore
records.tagline: Turns hours of team video and notes into searchable memory
records.description: Mnemcore turns your organization’s video into searchable, shared knowledge. Capture timestamped notes, search across every recording, and ask questions to get grounded answers linked directly to the original moments. Built for teams that rely on video but need a better way to remember, find, and act on what they see.

records.name: Swenest
records.tagline: A platform that teaches how to navigate real-world code.
records.description: Swenest stands out with real merged GitHub PRs as tasks, not artificial problems, symptom-only descriptions; users find the cause themselves, progressive AI hints that guide without spoiling, AI judge grading against the actual merged fix and XP-gated difficulty progression. Most platforms don't train navigating unfamiliar, real-world codebases with structured guidance with a gamified platform.

records.name: Blaxel Agent Drive
records.tagline: A shared filesystem for AI agents
records.description: Mount one distributed filesystem across multiple sandboxes with concurrent read-write access. Agents can share files, tool outputs, datasets, and context through a normal filesystem path.

records.name: NotifyBridge
records.tagline: Dead-Simple IoT Push Notifications for Makers & Hobbyists
records.description: The Absolute Easiest Way to Ping Your Phone NotifyBridge is the ultimate backend built for makers, smart home hobbyists, and developers who just want their hardware to work. Instead of spending hours fighting with heavy mobile SDKs, platform certificates, or massive cloud dashboards, our lightweight REST API lets any ESP32, Arduino, or Raspberry Pi project drop a simple webhook to trigger instant mobile alerts.

records.name: Nugget
records.tagline: Capture your rambles and keep what matters
records.description: Capture rambles locally, then organize them into useful ideas with optional cloud processing.

records.name: AuraSpeak
records.tagline: Break the English ↔ Japanese language barrier with a QR scan
records.description: Meet someone new with a QR code. Start a conversation in English or Japanese — live translation helps you connect. No install needed.

records.name: Findborg
records.tagline: A search engine with no ads
records.description: Findborg is a Find Engine -- web search, community knowledge from The Hive, and AI research via Borg, all in one place. No ads. No paid rankings. Businesses get found because they're worth finding.

records.name: Basedash AI Kit
records.tagline: Ship AI analytics in your product, powered by GPT-5.6
records.description: Basedash is the AI analytics platform — chat with an AI data analyst, automatic daily insights, automations, and dashboards. Now all of it is available through the API. Power your product's customer-facing analytics with a fully custom UI, or extend your internal BI in ways no tool anticipated. Send a question, stream the answer, render the chart — every query scoped to the right customer. Ranked #1 on BI Bench and powered by GPT-5.6. The AI data analyst, now yours to build on.

records.name: PromptScout
records.tagline: Increase your brand's AI visibility on autopilot
records.description: PromptScout shows whether your brand is visible in AI chats, which competitors are visible instead, and what to do next to get mentioned by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Bing Copilot. Monitor 5 AI platforms, connect Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and Live AI Traffic, then turn the evidence into weekly Tasks. Complete the tasks with an agent of your choice through PromptScout's MCP server.

records.name: Astartis x Codex
records.tagline: Enterprise developer security control plane around evidence
records.description: Astartis x Codex - evidence-led developer security control plane.

records.name: Vevey
records.tagline: A game development tutor now on iOS
records.description: Meet Matti, an AI tutor that helps you bring your game ideas to life. We've worked on popular games like https://www.landmarkr.app, and are providing a platform for others to build their own. Create without limits, get instruction on 2D & 3D projects, and even create daily games and puzzles like Landmarkr and Wordle via Game Guides. We'd love to hear from you!

records.name: HonorBox
records.tagline: Sell digital products with just Stripe and GitHub
records.description: Your storefront is a static site on GitHub Pages. Checkout is a Stripe Payment Link on your own account. A scheduled GitHub Action delivers each sale by inviting the buyer to your private repo.

records.name: RunEvr
records.tagline: Agentic project management environment for creatives
records.description: One AI-powered workspace where your projects, conversations, reviews, and creative work stay connected. Every tool switch interrupts creative thinking, scatters context, and adds unnecessary cognitive load. RunEvr is built to keep your entire creative workflow in one place, helping teams stay focused, collaborate naturally, and create without losing momentum.

records.name: Wispro
records.tagline: Stop typing, start talking, get perfectly written text
records.description: Wispro turns your voice into writing, instantly. Just talk, messy or unfiltered, and Wispro pastes clean, ready-to-use text directly into whatever you're working on. It adapts to how you think, not just how you speak. Basic Mode captures every word exactly as said. Smart Mode cuts filler words and rambling, formatting it into polished prose. Command Mode turns a spoken instruction into finished writing, emails, replies, whole drafts, on the spot. One voice. Three ways to write.

records.name: Squishy
records.tagline: the screen time pet you keep alive with someone
records.description: Squishy is an app and website blocker with a mascot whose happiness follows your choices. Focus helps it recover. Opening blocked apps or sites drains it. Share one Squishy with a partner, friend, or family member, and both of you contribute to the same happiness bar while browsing details stay private. One subscription covers the owner and one invited partner, with sync across iPhone, iPad, Android, and Chrome.

records.name: GTA DataCity
records.tagline: San Francisco co-working dataset visualized, as a game!
records.description: A tiny 3D platformer atlas of San Francisco's AI coworking spaces.

records.name: Cubby Clipboard
records.tagline: Windows clipboard history that searches inside screenshots
records.description: Cubby is the clipboard history Windows should have shipped. It keeps copied text, images, files, and screenshots searchable after restarts, while offline OCR lets you find a screenshot by the words inside it. Everything stays encrypted on your PC: no account, no cloud, no clipboard telemetry. Open it with a shortcut, search, and paste.

records.name: Rehello
records.tagline: Made for introverts to remember people & reconnect naturally
records.description: Rehello is a people-memory companion designed for introverts. After meeting someone, jot down a messy memory in your own words. GPT-5.6 turns it into a structured recall card—who they are, where you met, what matters to them, and an easy conversation opener for next time. Unlike a CRM, Rehello isn’t about networking or managing leads. It reduces the mental load of remembering people, so reconnecting feels natural, thoughtful, and less awkward.

records.name: AskCodi
records.tagline: Orchestrate agents at scale while reducing cost
records.description: Tell Codi what you want to build. It writes the plan, runs AI agents in parallel across all your projects, and picks the cheapest model that can do each task, so you ship more and spend less. When you add a project it writes the charter and task list itself, and only pulls you in when a decision needs you, through one inbox.

records.name: Chimlo
records.tagline: Track Codex and Claude Code and respond from your Notch
records.description: Chimlo is a free, open-source macOS app that puts Codex and Claude Code in your MacBook notch. See which agents are working, waiting, finished, or failed. Answer Claude Code questions, review permission requests, and check provider usage without hunting through terminal windows. Chimlo also handles media, volume, and brightness controls, with animated pixel companions that make every state easy to spot.

records.name: OpenCode Superapp
records.tagline: The power of Codex with local, self-hosted models and voice
records.description: OpenCode Superapp brings the agentic power of Codex to the models and infrastructure you choose. Run cloud, local, or self-hosted models in a native workspace where agents understand your projects, work with files, Git, and terminals, speak with you through voice, and operate Mac apps through supervised Computer Use. Private by design and extensible through skills and MCPs, it gives you capable agents without giving up model choice or control. Built from the ground up with Codex and GPT-5.6.

records.name: xPitch
records.tagline: Strava for casual Footballer
records.description: xPitch turns the GPS recording already on your smartwatch into football-specific match analysis. No dedicated tracker or fancy sensor needed. Upload FIT, GPX, or TCX files for heatmaps, movement trails, zones, sprints, heart-rate context, and estimated roles. Map a session to a real pitch, split play from rest, save matches with notes/photos in your account, share them, and export Story-ready graphics.

records.name: CrawlRaven
records.tagline: SEO Hub for GSC + GA4 + a 200-point crawl
records.description: Connect Google Search Console, Google Analytics, import your Ahrefs or Semrush lists, and crawl your site on 200-point technical SEO Audit. CrawlRaven joins all four and hands back a ranked plan: what to write, what to update, what to fix first.

records.name: PodcastorAI
records.tagline: Your AI twin hosts your video podcast
records.description: Create studio-quality video podcasts from scripts, links, PDFs, or ideas — with AI hosts, natural voices, and your digital twin. Podcastor handles production and puts you on screen, turning hours of recording and editing into a finished video podcast in around 15 minutes. Create solo or two-host episodes and get a publish-ready video without cameras or a production team. Already have an audio episode? Upload it and transform it into a video podcast with your voice and AI avatar.

records.name: Basement
records.tagline: Shopping browser with agentic checkout
records.description: Basement is now a shopping browser. Today we launch agentic checkout: your AI shopper finds the best price across the web and buys it for you. Every purchase runs on a single-use card scoped to one order, so your real card is never exposed and nothing goes beyond the budget you set. Every payment lands in one place. Powered by Crossmint. It knows what you like. Now it can buy it. Live on iOS and Chrome.

records.name: HOL Guard
records.tagline: The 1st Firewall for AI Agents
records.description: HOL Guard is the firewall for AI agents. It sits between agents and your systems, blocking high-risk actions before they happen like deleting production data to exposing secrets. Built by HOL, it’s free, open source, and already has 400K+ downloads.

records.name: El Niño
records.tagline: See live signals from the Pacific warming climate
records.description: El Niño is a recurring warming pattern in the tropical Pacific that can influence weather around the world. This iPhone app turns live public NOAA data into a simple answer: is that warming signal building, fading or still uncertain? See what changed, where the warm water sits and how similar events unfolded before. A Home Screen widget keeps the latest complete update nearby. Upfront paid once, with no account or subscription. Independent context, not a forecast or official guidance.

records.name: SMASH Voice to Invoice
records.tagline: Build and send quotes as fast as you can talk
records.description: I built this because every quote request cost me time and money. I'd stop working, scramble to remember my rates, type out a quote, lose the job to someone faster. SMASH lets me quote into my phone while I'm still on site. Talk the details, it pulls from my own pricing, sends instantly. Customer approves right there, I get paid, I keep moving. No context switching. No guessing rates. Just my numbers, my speed. Free on the App Store and Chrome extension. Five quotes a month free, full featured.

records.name: PenguinHarness
records.tagline: Let Agents Autonomously Build Better Agents for $0.02
records.description: PenguinHarness is an open-source self-improving harness built by the team behind LlamaFactory. Its AI-native SDK enables agents to build, evaluate, and optimize other agents. It supports 1,000+ models, reusable skills, tool and context management, automatic data generation, multi-agent evaluation, and closed-loop harness evolution. With one prompt and about $0.02, an agent can build a complete RAG application.

records.name: AI Eyes
records.tagline: Permission-first co-presence controls for AI companions
records.description: AI Eyes is a permission-first co-presence prototype for AI companions. Choose a screen or window to capture, control screen, system audio and microphone separately, invite named companions, and always see when sensing is active. Pause or end anytime; ending stops media tracks and resets the session. Built with Codex and GPT-5.6, v0.1 delivers the local-first permission, capture, presence and session-control foundation. No AI provider or semantic understanding is connected yet; that comes next.

records.name: canitbebuilt
records.tagline: Your hardware idea, inspected. Verdict, BOM, 3D model.
records.description: Have a hardware idea? Describe it in a sentence. You get back a verdict (Buildable / Buildable with changes / Heavy lift / Not viable), a bill of materials costed at 100, 1,000 and 10,000 units, subsystem risk ratings, certification gates for your market, and a 3D concept model. Two minutes, no signup. Criteria come from 23 years of hardware building. Running on GPT-5.6 Terra.

records.name: Caw
records.tagline: Open source web terminal multiplexer for AI agents
records.description: Caw is a web terminal multiplexer for OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Antigravity, and Pi. It makes it easy to monitor and interact with multiple agent sessions from anywhere, especially on mobile. Besides the terminal multiplexer itself, it includes: - Built-in file browser and editor - Kanban-like board showing all running agents - Push notifications whenever an agent finishes working or requests your input - Git worktrees on demand to parallelize work - Voice mode

records.name: Mufal
records.tagline: Undetectable AI copilot for live meetings
records.description: Mufal is a bot-free AI copilot that helps during live meetings—not only afterward. Get live transcription, contextual answers, an undetectable overlay during screen sharing, automatic notes, action items, and durable project memory. It works out of the box with Mufal-managed AI, while advanced users can bring their own API keys. Available on macOS, Windows, and iOS, with a free plan and optional cloud sync.

records.name: Motionly
records.tagline: AI-native motion graphics editor
records.description: Motionly is an open-source motion graphics editor built for the AI era. Instead of generating videos directly, AI generates editablemotion files that can be refined visually or in code. It combines a visual editor with a structured animation format, making motion graphics versionable, reusable, and easier for developers, designers, and AI agents to collaborate on.

records.name: Cosyra 2.0
records.tagline: A cloud workspace for coding agents from your phone
records.description: Cosyra gives you a persistent workspace for cloud agents. Your repos, branches, files, dependencies, terminals, and agent work stay together. Open it from your phone and keep building without leaving a laptop awake.

records.name: Fable Flight
records.tagline: Learn to fly with a live AI instructor
records.description: Fable Flight is a browser-based AI flight school with a multi-view 3D cockpit, landscape, weather, traffic, missions and the latest GPT real-time voice assistant to guide you along the way. This is an educational simulator; not certified flight training.

records.name: CartesiumAI
records.tagline: Learn by experimenting with a real-time AI companion
records.description: CartesiumAI turns learning into a live, evidence-driven process. Its context-aware 3D companion explains selected concepts, reads the learner’s journal and simulation state, and performs safe real-time demonstrations. Ten deterministic physics labs let learners predict, experiment, collect evidence, revise explanations, and build auditable reports. This can be extended to any other discipline, leading to a high-quality learning experience. Built end to end with Codex and designed for GPT-5.6.

records.name: Foalia
records.tagline: The ultimate SaaS platform for equine breeding management
records.description: Foalia is the ultimate SaaS platform designed to streamline equine breeding management. Say goodbye to messy spreadsheets and hello to smart, centralized tracking for your mares, veterinary schedules, and breeding statistics. Built by breeders for breeders, Foalia helps you save time, reduce errors, and make data-driven decisions for your stud farm. Manage your entire breeding operation effortlessly in one clean, powerful workspace.

records.name: XERIA
records.tagline: Secure, personalize, send and trace PDF documents
records.description: Secure PDF distribution with personalized watermarking, source identification, password protection, and traceability. XERIA generates recipient-specific PDFs, adds visible watermarks and embedded trace information, and helps organizations control confidential document sharing. Designed for training, legal, HR, and compliance teams. Now available on Microsoft Store, with an unlimited free trial before purchasing a license.

records.name: AI Act Compliance Navigator
records.tagline: Explainable AI compliance, grounded in evidence and action
records.description: AI Act Compliance Navigator turns a company questionnaire into an explainable EU AI Act and GDPR risk profile. Built with Codex and GPT-5.6 Sol, it combines deterministic scoring, source-linked regulatory intelligence, a grounded assistant, policy guardrails, multilingual workflows, and a Compliance Action Workspace to assign owners, due dates, evidence, and human approval. Unlike a generic legal chatbot, every recommendation stays connected to the company profile and reviewable evidence.

records.name: AlphaWatching
records.tagline: 10 AI agents turning market data into clear signals
records.description: AlphaWatching brings crypto, global stocks, Turkish stocks (BIST) and mutual funds (TEFAS) into one AI-powered analysis experience. Ten specialized agents examine market regime, technical signals, quantitative data, news, sentiment, volume, flows and risk. A Decision Agent combines the findings into a clear 0–100 score, key drivers and possible scenarios—without connecting to your broker or accessing your funds.

records.name: Trend Seeker
records.tagline: Market research and idea validation from 140K+ signals
records.description: Trend Seeker turns recurring demand from Reddit, job ads, podcasts, Google Trends, and product launches into business ideas you can inspect. Each idea shows the problem, source signals, demand trend, competition, opportunity score, and how the cluster changed over time. Browse 7.4K ideas built from 140K+ signals, explore the Demand Map, or validate your own idea against matching user requests. Free to explore, with Pro for full access.

records.name: Framewritten
records.tagline: Turn any website into a finished marketing video
records.description: Paste your website. Framewritten reads your business, writes the script, generates the voiceover, builds the visuals in code and delivers a finished, publish-ready marketing video in around 10 minutes. No templates, no timelines and no video editing. Just a video that's built around your business and ready to share.

records.name: AI Dimag
records.tagline: Verified memory for AI coding agents that proves it's true
records.description: AI Dimag gives MCP-compatible agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf) persistent memory that survives across sessions. Unlike traditional context systems, every memory carries falsifiable evidence—shell checks, tests, commit anchors—that dim verify re-runs against your current repo. Stale beliefs get flagged instead of silently misleading your AI. Works via MCP tools for real-time memory or generates static context files (.cursorrules, CLAUDE.md) for non-MCP tools. Free for teams ≤10.

records.name: CRC Toolbox
records.tagline: Zero-PHI, client-side utilities for clinical research teams
records.description: Enterprise clinical tools require logins and IT reviews just to run basic math. CRC Toolbox eliminates site friction with browser-native utilities that run 100% client-side without collecting PHI—safe for independent trial sites. Full Utility Suite: • Kit expiration tracker & lab specimen workbench • CAPA & deviation drafter • Visit window math with directics export • Instant CTCAE toxicity & lab criteria search • Clinical calculators (BSA, QTc) & GCP checklists Free, instant, 100% private.

records.name: LABO AI
records.tagline: Visual AI lab for designing neural networks
records.description: LABO AI is a visual workspace for designing, exploring, and executing neural network architectures directly in the browser. Build models by connecting typed blocks, inspect the generated PyTorch code in real time, execute graphs locally, and collaborate with AI agents that help design and refine architectures. Built for researchers, engineers, educators, and anyone exploring modern deep learning.

records.name: Fastrr by Shiprocket
records.tagline: India’s first AI‑native growth suite for eCommerce brands
records.description: Fastrr by Shiprocket is India's first AI-native pre-order commerce suite that helps eCommerce brands convert more visitors into customers. It brings together 11 AI-powered tools for checkout, shopping assistance, visitor identification, marketing automation, customer journeys, AI voice agents, performance marketing, and conversion optimization—all on one platform. Replace fragmented tools, engage shoppers smarter, and grow revenue with AI.

records.name: Tiny Brush Colouring Games App
records.tagline: Kids Fun Coloring Drawing Book
records.description: Looking for a fun and creative way to keep your kids entertained? Try Tiny Brush! This app offers plenty of coloring and drawing fun for kids of all ages. Let your child explore a world of color with our easy-to-use Coloring Games! With themes like animals, food, vehicles, shapes, geometry and nature, young artists can enjoy a creative adventure that sparks their imagination.

records.name: TrustGrowth
records.tagline: SEO you can verify. Open playbook. Public proof.
records.description: Every SEO tool gives you a report. Ours gives you proof. We audit your site from Search Console evidence into one verified TrustGrowth Score — technical SEO, performance, E-E-A-T, keywords, strategy — and publish it as a public proof page, weak signals included, with an embeddable badge and a rank on the public leaderboard. You approve what changes. The playbook we work from, Groundcrew, is open source: inspect the exact instructions, or run them with your own agent. Claim your rank.

records.name: AgentGuard
records.tagline: The AI agent firewall: catches hijacks that pass every rule
records.description: Spend limits cap the money. They can't see that your agent's intent changed. A €300 payment to an allowlisted merchant, under every cap. Every rule passes — and GPT-5.6 holds it anyway, because gift cards aren't the API credits the agent was authorized to buy. AgentGuard adds a GPT-5.6 intent firewall between your agents and the real world, plus a human approval gate, a tamper-evident ledger you can break yourself, and an MCP server any agent can plug into. Live demo, no signup, no API key.

records.name: Multiplayer Games
records.tagline: The easiest way to play games with friends, multiplayer fun
records.description: Multiplayer Games strips away the complexity of modern gaming and gets back to what matters: playing with someone you care about. We've curated 15+ games—from timeless classics to modern favorites—all playable offline, side-by-side with a friend or against our smart AI opponents. Want a quick game of Tic Tac Toe? Play Checkers to sharpen your strategy? Try Word Chain or Ludo? It's all here. Perfect for flights, road trips, waiting rooms, lunch breaks, or unplugging on the couch.

records.name: DeskClear
records.tagline: One Click to a Clutter-Free Desktop!
records.description: A simple one-click solution to clean your desktop files, quickly restoring a tidy workspace. DeskClear helps you stay efficient in a busy work environment by easily managing desktop clutter.

records.name: Vararuchi
records.tagline: what the first stroke cannot awaken, persistence will
records.description: Vararuchi is an AI tutor and personalized learning platform. Master any subject with Knowledge Mastery, OmniMath, Photo Solver, Language AI and an AI Career Coach — free to start.

Import up to four camera angles, sync them on one timeline, switch shots by tapping the active camera, refine every cut, and export a finished video or editable FCPXML/XML project. It is built for performances, interviews, events, family moments, and any shoot captured from multiple phones—without the complexity of a desktop editor.

records.name: Raliess
records.tagline: Earn while your ai thinks , Supports Upi transactions
records.description: You know the gap where you've sent a prompt to Claude/Copilot/ChatGPT and you're just sitting there watching it generate? The part that's actually relevant to this sub: almost everything in this space pays out through Stripe or PayPal, which for most of us means a registered business, invoices, or a payout you can't practically collect. Raliess pays straight to UPI, into your bank account. No company, no GST, no invoice. Minimum ₹800-ish per withdrawal.

records.name: VigyanLLM
records.tagline: AI Integrated Biology
records.description: VigyanLLM is an automated bioinformatics platform for primer design, molecular docking, sequence analysis, and drug discovery. Free online tools for researchers and students in computational biology.

records.name: Trilliant Software Pvt Ltd
records.tagline: Best HRMS Software in India
records.description: Compare the best HRMS software in India for 2026. Explore features, pricing, payroll, attendance, compliance, pros & cons, and choose the right HRMS for your business.

records.name: CrumbKit
records.tagline: Cookie editor you can trust. Free, open source, no ads.
records.description: EditThisCookie had 3M users before Chrome removed it. A shady clone immediately scammed 50K people. CrumbKit is my answer: a cookie editor that's free, open source (MIT), and 100% local — zero network requests, zero tracking. Features: privacy score (powered by Disconnect.me tracker DB), cookie classification, JSON/Netscape/cURL import & export, undo support, dark mode, domain whitelist. Built on Manifest V3. Part of the WayKnow family of privacy-first developer tools.

records.name: JobPrep Arena
records.tagline: Interactive technical interview practice terminal for tech
records.description: Preparing for a tech interview today goes way beyond standard coding puzzles. If you’re targeting tech roles, that’s why we built JobPrep Arena. An interactive terminal offering expert-crafted technical questions. It covers everything from distributed systems and cloud IAM to thread safety and network architecture. Features: 20+ Career Pathways 3 Experience Levels: Instant Explanations: Deep technical breakdowns after every question so you learn why an answer is correct on the spot.

records.name: SongSprig
records.tagline: Turn prompts and lyrics into complete AI songs
records.description: SongSprig turns a prompt, lyrics, or a song idea into a complete original track with vocals and instrumentals. Creators can make tracks up to eight minutes, then continue with browser-based tools for lyrics, key and BPM, audio conversion, MIDI, stem splitting, vocal removal, and more. A free plan is available without a credit card.

records.name: TopTierClass
records.tagline: AI-powered Google review replies in 5 minutes, 24/7
records.description: Most local businesses are too busy to keep up with Google reviews. TopTierClass connects to your Google Business Profile and drafts an AI reply within 5 minutes of every new review. 4-5★ reviews post automatically; 1-3★ reviews wait for one-click approval. Brand-voice customization, real Google API integration — not a scraper. $19.99/mo — first 7 days free, $0 due today.

records.name: Listmage
records.tagline: Turn an AliExpress URL into a full Shopify launch kit
records.description: Most AI listing tools write you a product description and stop. Listmage takes one AliExpress URL and generates the entire launch: SEO title, long-form description, feature bullets, meta tags, image alt text, Facebook and Google ad copy, and a three-step post-purchase email sequence, all in one brand voice. Push straight to Shopify, or bulk-generate your whole catalog from a CSV. Built for dropshippers and small agencies who are tired of paying for four separate apps to launch one product.

records.name: Fikry
records.tagline: A mis-trained AI powered by bad data and confidence
records.description: I am Fikry. I begin with good intentions, approach the right answer, then confidently miss the exit.

records.name: Canopy - Smart Plant Care
records.tagline: Canopy — identify and care for plants
records.description: Canopy combines AI-powered plant identification with practical plant care guidance. Simply take a photo, and the app instantly identifies the plant, provides key information about its species and habitat, and helps users better understand how to care for it. With a lightweight design, privacy-focused approach, and fast AI analysis, Canopy offers a simple all-in-one solution for plant lovers and beginners.

records.name: Quoridor
records.tagline: A classic abstract strategy board game
records.description: The rules are simple: move your pawn to the opposite side of the board before your opponent does. But there's a twist — you can place walls to block their path! Features: - Play against AI opponents at multiple difficulty levels - Clean, minimalist board design - Smooth animations and haptic feedback - Dark and light themes - No internet connection required — play anywhere!

records.name: Exigia
records.tagline: Prove every requirement is met — in one click
records.description: Exigia turns any spec (PDF, Word, email) into a living requirements tree, links each one to the deliverable that answers it, and generates a one-click compliance report. AI-assisted, bring-your-own-key, and it never stores your files.

records.name: QuizCraft
records.tagline: Turn your notes into flashcards + quizzes instantly with AI
records.description: Studying shouldn't mean hours making flashcards manually. QuizCraft turns your notes or PDFs into ready-to-use flashcards and quizzes in seconds — powered by AI. 📚 Upload notes → get 20 flashcards instantly 🎯 Auto-generated multiple choice quizzes 🔥 Exam Crunch Mode — AI builds your daily study plan based on your exam date 📊 Track progress and study streaks Perfect for college students, high school students, and certification exam prep. Start free. No credit card required.

records.name: Basement
records.tagline: Shopping browser with agentic checkout
records.description: Basement is now a shopping browser. Today we launch agentic checkout: your AI shopper finds the best price across the web and buys it for you. Every purchase runs on a single-use card scoped to one order, so your real card is never exposed and nothing goes beyond the budget you set. Every payment lands in one place. Powered by Crossmint. It knows what you like. Now it can buy it. Live on iOS and Chrome.

records.name: EnglishGPT
records.tagline: The best way to increase your English grades
records.description: EnglishGPT helps 10th-grade students prepare for their IGCSE English exams. It’s a website that provides you with a custom study roadmap, marks your essays, gives you feedback and study notes, and helps students rapidly increase their test scores.

records.name: Megaphone
records.tagline: Open-source Mac dictation App that's 100% on-device
records.description: Hold Fn, speak, and Megaphone types clean text into any Mac app. Apple’s SpeechAnalyzer transcribes as you talk, while on-device Foundation Models remove fillers, fix self-corrections, adapt to app context, and power inline voice commands. No account, API key, subscription, or server. Free, MIT-licensed, and native to Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26.

records.name: SMASH Voice to Invoice
records.tagline: Build and send quotes as fast as you can talk
records.description: I built this because every quote request cost me time and money. I'd stop working, scramble to remember my rates, type out a quote, lose the job to someone faster. SMASH lets me quote into my phone while I'm still on site. Talk the details, it pulls from my own pricing, sends instantly. Customer approves right there, I get paid, I keep moving. No context switching. No guessing rates. Just my numbers, my speed. Free on the App Store and Chrome extension. Five quotes a month free, full featured.

records.name: Caw
records.tagline: Open source web terminal multiplexer for AI agents
records.description: Caw is a web terminal multiplexer for OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Antigravity, and Pi. It makes it easy to monitor and interact with multiple agent sessions from anywhere, especially on mobile. Besides the terminal multiplexer itself, it includes: - Built-in file browser and editor - Kanban-like board showing all running agents - Push notifications whenever an agent finishes working or requests your input - Git worktrees on demand to parallelize work - Voice mode

records.name: HonorBox
records.tagline: Sell digital products with just Stripe and GitHub
records.description: Your storefront is a static site on GitHub Pages. Checkout is a Stripe Payment Link on your own account. A scheduled GitHub Action delivers each sale by inviting the buyer to your private repo.

records.name: PodcastorAI
records.tagline: Your AI twin hosts your video podcast
records.description: Create studio-quality video podcasts from scripts, links, PDFs, or ideas — with AI hosts, natural voices, and your digital twin. Podcastor handles production and puts you on screen, turning hours of recording and editing into a finished video podcast in around 15 minutes. Create solo or two-host episodes and get a publish-ready video without cameras or a production team. Already have an audio episode? Upload it and transform it into a video podcast with your voice and AI avatar.

records.name: PenguinHarness
records.tagline: Let Agents Autonomously Build Better Agents for $0.02
records.description: PenguinHarness is an open-source self-improving harness built by the team behind LlamaFactory. Its AI-native SDK enables agents to build, evaluate, and optimize other agents. It supports 1,000+ models, reusable skills, tool and context management, automatic data generation, multi-agent evaluation, and closed-loop harness evolution. With one prompt and about $0.02, an agent can build a complete RAG application.

records.name: CrawlRaven
records.tagline: SEO Hub for GSC + GA4 + a 200-point crawl
records.description: Connect Google Search Console, Google Analytics, import your Ahrefs or Semrush lists, and crawl your site on 200-point technical SEO Audit. CrawlRaven joins all four and hands back a ranked plan: what to write, what to update, what to fix first.

records.name: ReExplain
records.tagline: Explain what you know to AI and discover what you don't
records.description: Most AI learning tools explain things to you. ReExplain flips that interaction: instead of AI explaining a concept to you, you explain it to AI in your own words. It listens, asks thoughtful follow-up questions, and helps reveal what you truly understand - and where the gaps are. Your sessions become evidence of your learning, generating focused practice and building a mastery map that grows over time.

records.name: LapuAi
records.tagline: OS Driver for AI to use computers
records.description: Our bet is the mix nobody ships: a chat agent that lives on your real PC, not a VM with the precision of RPA and the range of a real assistant. Most "computer use" tools: OpenAI's Operator, Anthropic's Computer Use take a screenshot, ask an AI where to click, and move the mouse by coordinates, usually on a cloud VM. Reliable computer use comes from talking to the OS directly through its accessibility and UI-automation APIs, not from a smarter model guessing where a button is.

records.name: Teable 3.0
records.tagline: AI Spreadsheet for Business
records.description: Turn your business data into AI workflows and custom apps. Connect any system, migrate any data, and build anything that fits your business 100%.

records.name: Squishy
records.tagline: the screen time pet you keep alive with someone
records.description: Squishy is an app and website blocker with a mascot whose happiness follows your choices. Focus helps it recover. Opening blocked apps or sites drains it. Share one Squishy with a partner, friend, or family member, and both of you contribute to the same happiness bar while browsing details stay private. One subscription covers the owner and one invited partner, with sync across iPhone, iPad, Android, and Chrome.

records.name: AVE
records.tagline: Local-first AI video editor for Mac
records.description: AVE is a local-first AI video editor for Mac. It helps creators import footage, analyze transcripts and visual notes, search by what appears or is said in clips, then turn selected footage into reviewable timeline work. AVE is useful for launch videos, B-roll search, interview highlights, generated-footage assembly, and private local editing where the project should stay on the Mac by default.

records.name: BioScript
records.tagline: Self-hosted white label link-in-bio
records.description: BioScript gives you the builder, the licensing system, and the reseller dashboard — fully white-labeled, self-hosted. One-time cost. No platform tax. No powered-by tag.

records.name: Pulse
records.tagline: Your company's permission-aware, proactive and agentic brain
records.description: Most AI tools start each session blank and answer with no way to check them. Pulse is your company's brain. It connects Slack, email, docs, meetings, and 25 tools into one permission-aware memory, then answers anything with a citation on every line. Decisions get captured once and never re-explained. It finds the right expert, runs agents you approve, builds reports from real data, and works by voice. And it lives inside Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT over MCP.

records.name: Vevey
records.tagline: A game development tutor now on iOS
records.description: Meet Matti, an AI tutor that helps you bring your game ideas to life. We've worked on popular games like https://www.landmarkr.app, and are providing a platform for others to build their own. Create without limits, get instruction on 2D & 3D projects, and even create daily games and puzzles like Landmarkr and Wordle via Game Guides. We'd love to hear from you!

records.name: Quaso
records.tagline: AI automation agent to get stuff done across apps or browser
records.description: Quaso turns your busywork into automation across all of your apps and the open web. Simply prompt what needs to get done and it builds and sets it up for you. Connects to 3000+ integrations (Gmail, Slack, Linear, Stripe, etc.) and picks up a real browser when there's no native API. Runs on schedules, triggers, and on demand. Fork templates or save any thread as your own reusable skill. Tag @Quaso in Slack so your whole team can put it to work. Just relax and get stuff done.

records.name: RunEvr
records.tagline: Agentic project management environment for creatives
records.description: One AI-powered workspace where your projects, conversations, reviews, and creative work stay connected. Every tool switch interrupts creative thinking, scatters context, and adds unnecessary cognitive load. RunEvr is built to keep your entire creative workflow in one place, helping teams stay focused, collaborate naturally, and create without losing momentum.

records.name: Mnemcore
records.tagline: Turns hours of team video and notes into searchable memory
records.description: Mnemcore turns your organization’s video into searchable, shared knowledge. Capture timestamped notes, search across every recording, and ask questions to get grounded answers linked directly to the original moments. Built for teams that rely on video but need a better way to remember, find, and act on what they see.

records.name: Speakworld
records.tagline: Learn languages by exploring worlds and talking to locals.
records.description: Speakworld — learn Hindi, Japanese and Spanish through playable journeys.

records.name: Swenest
records.tagline: A platform that teaches how to navigate real-world code.
records.description: Swenest stands out with real merged GitHub PRs as tasks, not artificial problems, symptom-only descriptions; users find the cause themselves, progressive AI hints that guide without spoiling, AI judge grading against the actual merged fix and XP-gated difficulty progression. Most platforms don't train navigating unfamiliar, real-world codebases with structured guidance with a gamified platform.

records.name: El Niño
records.tagline: See live signals from the Pacific warming climate
records.description: El Niño is a recurring warming pattern in the tropical Pacific that can influence weather around the world. This iPhone app turns live public NOAA data into a simple answer: is that warming signal building, fading or still uncertain? See what changed, where the warm water sits and how similar events unfolded before. A Home Screen widget keeps the latest complete update nearby. Upfront paid once, with no account or subscription. Independent context, not a forecast or official guidance.

records.name: Blaxel Agent Drive
records.tagline: A shared filesystem for AI agents
records.description: Mount one distributed filesystem across multiple sandboxes with concurrent read-write access. Agents can share files, tool outputs, datasets, and context through a normal filesystem path.

records.name: AgentLoop
records.tagline: Starts a fresh Codex worker and critic every cycle
records.description: Unlike long-running agent chats, AgentLoop starts a fresh Codex worker and critic every cycle. Set the goal and GUIDELINES.md rubric once; workers build, critics test, and failures become concrete fix notes for the next clean context. Project files carry the memory. Runs stay local, sandboxed, observable, and cancellable from a live dashboard, with ChatGPT control through MCP. Polish mode can continue beyond PASS until the critic says SHIP. Open source and zero-dependency Node.js.

records.name: Mufal
records.tagline: Undetectable AI copilot for live meetings
records.description: Mufal is a bot-free AI copilot that helps during live meetings—not only afterward. Get live transcription, contextual answers, an undetectable overlay during screen sharing, automatic notes, action items, and durable project memory. It works out of the box with Mufal-managed AI, while advanced users can bring their own API keys. Available on macOS, Windows, and iOS, with a free plan and optional cloud sync.

records.name: NotifyBridge
records.tagline: Dead-Simple IoT Push Notifications for Makers & Hobbyists
records.description: The Absolute Easiest Way to Ping Your Phone NotifyBridge is the ultimate backend built for makers, smart home hobbyists, and developers who just want their hardware to work. Instead of spending hours fighting with heavy mobile SDKs, platform certificates, or massive cloud dashboards, our lightweight REST API lets any ESP32, Arduino, or Raspberry Pi project drop a simple webhook to trigger instant mobile alerts.

records.name: Motionly
records.tagline: AI-native motion graphics editor
records.description: Motionly is an open-source motion graphics editor built for the AI era. Instead of generating videos directly, AI generates editablemotion files that can be refined visually or in code. It combines a visual editor with a structured animation format, making motion graphics versionable, reusable, and easier for developers, designers, and AI agents to collaborate on.

records.name: Wispro
records.tagline: Stop typing, start talking, get perfectly written text
records.description: Wispro turns your voice into writing, instantly. Just talk, messy or unfiltered, and Wispro pastes clean, ready-to-use text directly into whatever you're working on. It adapts to how you think, not just how you speak. Basic Mode captures every word exactly as said. Smart Mode cuts filler words and rambling, formatting it into polished prose. Command Mode turns a spoken instruction into finished writing, emails, replies, whole drafts, on the spot. One voice. Three ways to write.

records.name: Nugget
records.tagline: Capture your rambles and keep what matters
records.description: Capture rambles locally, then organize them into useful ideas with optional cloud processing.

records.name: AuraSpeak
records.tagline: Break the English ↔ Japanese language barrier with a QR scan
records.description: Meet someone new with a QR code. Start a conversation in English or Japanese — live translation helps you connect. No install needed.

records.name: Findborg
records.tagline: A search engine with no ads
records.description: Findborg is a Find Engine -- web search, community knowledge from The Hive, and AI research via Borg, all in one place. No ads. No paid rankings. Businesses get found because they're worth finding.

records.name: Fly X
records.tagline: Explore the world below even offline
records.description: Fly X turns the time between takeoff and landing into part of the trip. Before boarding, it saves your route and useful destination context so you can follow simulated flight progress, discover the places below, ask questions from saved journey knowledge, and arrive with guides, plans, and phrases ready—even without a signal. This launch is an interactive early prototype built around one KTW → CTA journey, designed to test what an offline flight companion could become.

records.name: Codex Quota Panel
records.tagline: Keep Codex quota and reset credits visible at a glance
records.description: A free, open-source Windows dashboard built with Codex for official Codex weekly quota, reset time, all available reset-credit cards, today’s tokens, and lifetime usage. Reset credits run only after selecting a card and confirming the action.

records.name: RentalHandover
records.tagline: Digital handover and return protocols for rental businesses.
records.description: Digital handover protocols for boat, vehicle and equipment rentals. Fast, clear, legally secure. Multi-lingual SaaS for rental companies.

records.name: Entag
records.tagline: Instant quotes for custom manufacturing
records.description: Entag's instant quoting engine just went live. Upload a 3D/2D file and get an instant quote for CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, 3D printing, or tube formation, no minimum order quantity, lead times from 3 business days. Entag has already produced over a million parts.

records.name: SıraPusula
records.tagline: Track your real Google rankings by location and device
records.description: SıraPusula is a location-aware Google rank tracker for marketers, agencies, and site owners. Check organic positions by keyword, country or city, and desktop or mobile; save searches, track keywords over time, and turn measurements into clean PDF reports. New users can try it free without creating an account.

records.name: Kinship Vault
records.tagline: Zero-knowledge document and photo vault
records.description: Kinship Vault seals your passports, IDs, wills, health cards and photos behind hardware encryption on your own device. No account, no cloud, no analytics. Recovery is cryptographic: a passphrase you hold, or a circle of people you trust. There is no reset link, because there is no key on our side to reset with. Now native on Mac.

records.name: Mock Video
records.tagline: Turn raw screen recordings into App Store-ready previews.
records.description: Say goodbye to red rejection symbols. Mock Video takes the nightmare out of Apple’s strict App Preview video specs, converting your raw recordings into perfectly formatted previews for iOS, macOS, tvOS, and visionOS in seconds. Whether the original video in the Portrait orientation or in the Landscape orientation, whether it has wrong dimensions or not, Mock Video will do its job wonderfully in exporting a final video you to disk.

records.name: JSON Support
records.tagline: JSON & CSV to Excel, instantly — free, no signup
records.description: JSON Support turns JSON or CSV data into a clean, formatted Excel file in one step — paste your data or drop a file, get axlsx back. No account, no email, nothing stored on our servers. Built for developers pulling an API response into a report, analysts handling a Firebase/Mongo export, or anyone who just needs JSON in a spreadsheet without writing a script. Sortable preview before you convert, dark mode included.

records.name: StayAfloat
records.tagline: Ultimate wellness app
records.description: StayAfloat is your personal wellness companion designed to help you breathe easier, think clearer, sleep better, and stay emotionally balanced — every single day. Whether you want to reduce stress, build confidence, feel grounded, or just add more calm to your routine, StayAfloat brings simple, science-backed tools together in one peaceful app.

records.name: VeloIQ
records.tagline: Build local-first Python CRUD database UIs in minutes.
records.description: VeloIQ is an open-source, pro-code Python framework that lets you build full-stack, data-driven applications in minutes to hours. You define your data models once in Python—and VeloIQ automatically generates the REST API, the SQLAdmin back-office, and a full React CRUD UI. Secure, production-ready, Enterprise-grade, AI-first applications. Your data don't have to leave your infrastructure. Native compiled speed and built-in transactional layouts. Already trusted with over 12,000 downloads.

records.name: Meilleur du Meilleur
records.tagline: Les meilleurs produits selon Reddit
records.description: Meilleur du Meilleur transforme des milliers d’avis Reddit en classements produits clairs pour les acheteurs français. Le site analyse les discussions publiques, repère les avantages et défauts qui reviennent souvent, puis attribue une note de consensus par catégorie. Objectif : choisir plus vite un bon produit, sans tests sponsorisés ni discours marketing.

records.name: Ravenspire
records.tagline: Mission control for your AI coding agents
records.description: Every Claude Code & OpenAI Codex session becomes a hero in a live pixel-art guild — tasks are quests, work is battle, the biggest project is a world boss. Under the game: a real ops panel with token/cost/labor analytics, response-time tracking, and "needs you" alerts. Zero build, MIT.

records.name: Qr Egg
records.tagline: Create, manage & track branded QR codes that never go stale
records.description: Create branded, dynamic QR codes that stay useful long after they're printed. Manage all your QR codes from one dashboard, update destinations without reprinting, track scan analytics, generate QR codes in bulk, and integrate with your existing workflows using APIs. Perfect for marketing campaigns, restaurants, product packaging, business cards, events, Google Reviews, and customer engagement.

records.name: Clawie by Jame
records.tagline: AI for vibe shipping not waiting
records.description: Clawie is the terminal coding agent from the Jame AI ecosystem. Plan, edit, debug, and verify code changes with repo-aware workflows and local-model control. Part of JameClaw and JameFlow.

records.name: InterviewKit
records.tagline: LeetCode is dead, let Codex conduct technical interviews
records.description: I built InterviewKit because technical interviews should reflect how engineers actually work with AI. Candidates use Codex to complete a real task, but they still have to drive the process: choosing an approach, making trade-offs, directing the code, testing it, and dealing with failures. Employers see more than the final output. They get a clearer picture of the candidate’s judgment and how they work.

records.name: WidgetSpark
records.tagline: Live widgets for your Windows desktop
records.description: 100+ beautiful desktop widgets for Windows 10 & 11. Clocks, system monitors, weather, crypto, music player, live wallpapers, stickers, and more. Lightweight at under 20 MB.

records.name: PyInferenceManager
records.tagline: Smart orchestration for LLM - across local and cloud models
records.description: PyInferenceManager intelligently routes LLM workloads across local and cloud models, optimizing for cost, latency, privacy, and quality. Build multi-step AI workflows without manually selecting providers or managing execution logic. Try - pip install PyInferenceManager

records.name: Sense
records.tagline: Feedbacks in, shipped features out
records.description: Record tester feedback on any web page — mic and tab audio, screen, or a snapshot — in one click, nothing to install first. Sense turns the recordings into a backlog drafted from what your testers actually said, every task linked to the tester who said it and the verbatim quote. Then hand a task to your AI agent: one click copies a ready-made brief, and the agent pulls the insights and quotes over MCP — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or anything that speaks it.

records.name: Leo: 21 Day Habit Builder
records.tagline: Build one habit at a time, in just 21 days
records.description: Leo is a minimalist habit app built around a simple idea: one goal, one focus, 21 days. Instead of overwhelming you with dozens of habits, Leo helps you commit to one meaningful challenge until it becomes part of your routine. Stay motivated with daily check-ins, visual progress, encouraging reminders, and a supportive companion that celebrates every step—including helping you recover after a missed day.

records.name: Illucid - Digital Mind Melter
records.tagline: Turn off your mind, relax and float downstream
records.description: Illucid applies an audio-reactive Deep Dream-inspired evolving neural style to live video. It makes things look very trippy! Shuffle through over 10^2466 possible neural style combinations, and then tweak them with modifiers to suit your taste.

records.name: NertRush
records.tagline: The real-time solitaire race for iOS.
records.description: Most solitaire games make you play alone. NertRush turns solitaire into a shared, simultaneous race inspired by Nerts (also called Nertz). Clear your 13-card Nerts pile before your rivals while everyone builds on the same center foundations in real time. Learn with a hands-on tutorial, race 1-4 bots across three difficulty levels, or play 1-on-1 online through Game Center. Native iPhone controls, hints, haptics, saved matches, and achievements keep every round quick and competitive.

records.name: papotons.chat
records.tagline: Temporary dating cards for real local meetups
records.description: Papotons is a French local dating platform where people publish temporary cards, receive direct replies and arrange real-life meetups. No endless swiping, no likes to collect, and no permanent public profile.

records.name: Mandou Virou
records.tagline: WhatsApp vira pedido impresso em 3 segundos
records.description: O Mandou Virou imprime pedidos do WhatsApp automaticamente na impressora térmica do seu balcão em 3 segundos. O sistema entende a mensagem natural do cliente (itens, adicionais, endereço, pagamento) e monta o cupom completo para a cozinha, sem ninguém digitar nada. Usado por mais de 150 pizzarias, lanchonetes, hamburguerias e açaiterias no Brasil. Funciona com impressoras térmicas 58mm e 80mm (USB, rede ou Bluetooth). Teste grátis de 7 dias, sem cartão e sem fidelidade.

records.name: Uvoz
records.tagline: Share files temporarily with controlled access & AI insights
records.description: Uvoz combines temporary file sharing with email-based access control. Senders can use expiring public or private links, verify uploads with email OTP, whitelist recipient emails, and approve, deny, revoke, or restore private access from a dashboard and email notification. New AI tools summarize file risk and convert plain-English sharing instructions into recommended settings, while recipients can optionally scan files for malware before downloading.

records.name: Balance Wise iOS App
records.tagline: Budget clearly, spend confidently.
records.description: Know exactly what may be left after bills with Balance Wise, a simple manual UK cash flow planner for iPhone. See your real available balance ahead without connecting to your bank.

records.name: ToolsVerse
records.tagline: 150+ Free Online Tools, All in One Place
records.description: ToolsVerse is your all-in-one platform for 150+ free online tools designed to simplify everyday work. Whether you need to edit PDFs, compress images, convert files, generate QR codes, use calculators, format text, or access developer utilities, everything is available in one place. No downloads, no sign-ups, and no unnecessary complexity—just fast, secure, and reliable tools that help students, professionals, creators, and developers get more done in less time.

records.name: Digital Foreman Suite
records.tagline: Three free offline apps for contractors - no accounts, ever
records.description: Three free apps built by a contractor with 30 years in the field: • Change Order Generator — write up extra work, run markup and tax, both sign on the phone, signed PDF before the work starts. • Bid Leveler — level sub bids apples-to-apples and see which number is actually complete. • Punch List — punch the job by room and trade, close out with both signatures. 100% offline. No account, no subscription — everything stays on your phone. Suite Pro ($29.99 once) adds your logo.

records.name: Savix
records.tagline: Your AI-Powered Personal Finance Companion.
records.description: Most expense trackers only record transactions—they don't help you make better financial decisions. records.name: FormLab ELN

records.name: ScanTally

records.description: ScanTally is a hardware-free web POS for small retailers. Generate secure QR codes with hidden minimum prices to guide staff during bargaining without leaking costs. Staff use standalone apps via a unique Scanner ID to bill items, completely hiding profit data. Includes GST invoice printing, a central profit tracker, and real-time sales dashboards. Perfect for Small Grocery, boutiques, and multi-counter stores looking to digitize checkouts securely using just their smartphones.

records.name: Color Dice
records.tagline: Roll custom color dice for games, classes, and groups
records.description: Color Dice is a free browser-based tool for rolling one to six color dice. Choose a 4-color or 6-color set, add custom colors, then roll with a button or the space bar. It includes fullscreen mode, sound, roll history, setup sharing, and a separate three-dice color-matching game with Quick Play and a 10-Round Challenge. No sign-up, downloads, betting, or real money—results are generated locally in your browser.

records.name: Destiny Matrix

records.name: Speed of Light (PRO)
records.tagline: The Fastest Way to Speed Up WordPress — Speed of Light
records.description: Speed of Light is an all-in-one WordPress performance plugin. It combines three layers of caching — a static disk page cache, a built-in Redis object cache, and full-page caching at Cloudflare's edge (on the free plan) — with automatic CSS, JavaScript, image, and font optimization. A real-browser cloud engine works out exactly what each page needs, and Autopilot applies the safe fixes for you. The result: green Core Web Vitals without a developer, a stack of plugins, or a monthly CDN bill.

records.name: Kovasign
records.tagline: Send, sign, and track documents - no envelope math

records.name: Speaker Cleaner

records.description: Speaker Cleaner plays a gentle 150–190 Hz sound sweep locally in your browser to help move water near your phone's speaker grille. It's free, works on iPhone and Android, and requires no app, account, microphone, or upload.

records.name: PDFBase

records.name: Focuslio
records.tagline: Free all-in-one app: Tasks, Notes, Projects, Calendar, Timer
records.description: Focuslio is a productivity platform that lets you create, organize, and customize your tasks, notes, and projects within dedicated workspaces, so everything stays clear, structured, and under your control. It also includes daily inspirational quotes, a personal AI assistant, a Pomodoro-like timer, and an activity heatmap of completed tasks. All data syncs across your devices (web, desktop, and android). Optimized for both personal and team use, the app is free to use with an optional pro plan.

records.name: StockWotch
records.tagline: Barcode inventory tracking that syncs with your team
records.description: StockWotch is the fastest way to run a physical inventory from your phone. Most importantly, get custom alerts on an item's in/out status. Scan a barcode to add or find an item in seconds, keep counts accurate across your whole team with real-time cloud sync and import your existing spreadsheet via CSV. Built for small businesses, resellers, collectors, and warehouses — anyone who needs to know what they have and where it is. Free to start. Pro adds unlimited items and team collaboration.

records.name: Obscuryn
records.tagline: AI-powered brand protection and takedown automation
records.description: Obscuryn protects your brand across domains, social media, mobile app stores, and the dark web — detecting lookalike domains, impersonating profiles, fake apps, and leaked credentials, with managed takedowns.

records.name: Claude Usage Tracker
records.tagline: Never hit a Claude limit by surprise again
records.description: A Chrome extension that shows your Claude usage right where you chat: session & weekly limits, reset countdowns, and a live "time left at this pace" projection. Private on-device analytics, no account needed — nothing leaves your browser.

records.name: tibly
records.tagline: Feels like you ordered. But you did not pay.
records.description: tibly helps you spend less on food delivery without relying on willpower. Browse restaurants, fill your cart, and go through checkout just like a real delivery app, but no order is placed. Instead, you’ll see how much money you saved. With streaks, achievements, challenges, and savings insights, tibly makes resisting impulse orders rewarding and helps you build better spending habits.

records.name: Cosyra 2.0
records.tagline: A cloud workspace for coding agents from your phone
records.description: Cosyra gives you a persistent workspace for cloud agents. Your repos, branches, files, dependencies, terminals, and agent work stay together. Open it from your phone and keep building without leaving a laptop awake.

records.name: OpenCode Superapp
records.tagline: The power of Codex with local, self-hosted models and voice
records.description: OpenCode Superapp brings the agentic power of Codex to the models and infrastructure you choose. Run cloud, local, or self-hosted models in a native workspace where agents understand your projects, work with files, Git, and terminals, speak with you through voice, and operate Mac apps through supervised Computer Use. Private by design and extensible through skills and MCPs, it gives you capable agents without giving up model choice or control. Built from the ground up with Codex and GPT-5.6.

records.name: Fable Flight
records.tagline: Learn to fly with a live AI instructor
records.description: Fable Flight is a browser-based AI flight school with a multi-view 3D cockpit, landscape, weather, traffic, missions and the latest GPT real-time voice assistant to guide you along the way. This is an educational simulator; not certified flight training.
